in_marathi.name: Jyotsana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jyotsana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jyotsana is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘jyot’ which means star or radiant. The name Jyotsana is a feminine form and is associated with the divine goddess of knowledge and wisdom, Saraswati.
